title: Greenhouse Jobs Search
description: Type a job title and press Start: you get the newest matching jobs from every company on Greenhouse (8,378 job boards, 216,000+ open jobs). Every other field is optional. Press Start with the form empty for the newest jobs of every kind.

searchTerms.title: Job titles to find (searchTerms)
searchTerms.description: Type the job titles or keywords to find, one per line, for example software engineer. A job matches when its title has every word of a line: frontend also finds Front-End. Leave it empty to get the newest jobs of every kind. A pasted Google dork such as site:boards.greenhouse.io intext:engineer, or a Greenhouse link, works too.

location.title: Where the job is (location)
location.description: Type where the jobs should be: a city, state, country or region, one per line, for example London, Germany, EMEA or LatAm. Greenhouse keeps locations as the company typed them: United States finds the jobs that name the country, and many US jobs give only a city and state, so add the city or the state code (TX) too. Worldwide finds the jobs open everywhere; Remote here asks for remote jobs. Leave it empty for anywhere.

workType.title: Remote or onsite (workType)
workType.description: Pick remote, hybrid or onsite, or several. Leave it empty for all of them. Greenhouse has no work type of its own: it comes from the company's own job fields, or from words such as Remote in the location or title, and a job that says neither is left out once you pick one. Typed words such as wfh work too.

postedWithin.title: Posted in the last (postedWithin)
postedWithin.description: Pick how new the jobs must be: posted in the last 24 hours, 3 days, 7 days or 30 days. Any time, the default, keeps every open job, newest first. The date is when the company first published the job, so an edit to an old job does not make it new. You can also type your own period, such as 48 hours or 2 weeks.

maxJobs.title: Number of jobs (maxJobs)
maxJobs.description: Type how many jobs to get, newest first: 100 by default. Type 0 to get every matching job. Each job is one charged row, so this also sets the most a run can cost.

includeDetails.title: Full details (includeDetails)
includeDetails.description: Tick to add the full details of each job: the description as text and HTML, the department, the company's reference number, and the pay as numbers with its currency. The run reads each saved job once more. A job with details costs $1.90 per 1,000 instead of $1.80.

excludeTerms.title: Leave out words (excludeTerms)
excludeTerms.description: Type words that leave a job out when its title has them, one per line, for example senior or manager. Leave it empty to keep every job.

employmentType.title: Job type (employmentType)
employmentType.description: Pick the job type: full-time, part-time, contract, internship or temporary, or several. Leave it empty for every job type. Greenhouse has no job type of its own, so only jobs whose company states one in its own job fields can match, about 1 in 6. Typed words such as freelance or temp work too.

searchDescriptions.title: Match descriptions (searchDescriptions)
searchDescriptions.description: Tick to match your keywords in the job description too, not only in the title: kubernetes then finds every job that asks for Kubernetes. Greenhouse sends descriptions only when asked, so the run downloads every description of every board: it is slower and uses up to about 1 GB of memory.

companies.title: Only these companies (companies)
companies.description: Type company names to search only them, one per line: a name (Stripe), the board name in the address (stripe) or a Greenhouse link (job-boards.greenhouse.io/stripe). A company that is not on our list is tried by its name, and its link always works. Leave it empty to search every company.

jobUrls.title: Job links to check (jobUrls)
jobUrls.description: Paste Greenhouse job links to check whether they are still open, one per line, instead of searching. Each link comes back open with the job, closed, or not found. Links on boards.greenhouse.io, job-boards.greenhouse.io, the EU boards and embed links work, and so do company career pages with ?gh_jid= for companies on our list.
